name: OCS sampler groups (switch method by step, percent or sigma)
plain: One OCS Sampler holds a chain of groups. Each group says when it applies, by step number, share of the steps or sigma, and which step methods it runs. At every step the first group whose window matches does the work, so euler can run the first few steps and dpmpp_sde the rest inside one sampler.
math:
Symbols: s step index; N steps; σ current sigma.
Group g applies when: step mode t0 ≤ s ≤ t1; percent mode t0 ≤ s/N ≤ t1; sigma mode t0 ≥ σ ≥ t1.
Bounds are inclusive. The first matching group in the chain runs the step.
